name: Drop Chamber
design_intent:
OWNER SEED: the CYLINDER-with-a-hole-in-the-bottom (v1_level_circuit.md §L-3, build-first-de-risk). An enclosed glossy 'arena drum': NON-lethal bumper walls up both sides + a NON-lethal bumper CEILING lid seal the box on three sides; the ONLY lethal exit is a ~680px HOLE in the CENTRE of the bottom floor, open to a bottomless void. Kill-shape class = enclosed_hole -> QA uses DC1 (not K1, not even K1'): a ~100% bottom/pit share is a PASS by construction (docs/specs/v2a_kill_shape_void_floor_addendum.md §3). IDENTITY = the deliberate INVERSE of islands-over-void: normally the EDGES kill and the middle is safe; here the edges + ceiling SAVE (bumper_restitution 0.86 bounces you back in) and the CENTRE kills. You fight to knock rivals DOWN through the hole while not getting funnelled in; ricochets off the bumper lid rain players back toward the mouth (a mis-aimed super into the lid rebounds you toward the hole = self-destruct comedy; a super aimed DOWN into a clustered rival over the hole is the money shot).

ENGINE FEASIBILITY (resolved, NO gap): the §L-3 arc/segment-collider flag is NOT needed. The enclosure is built from the sanctioned rectangle/polyline fallback — axis-aligned tier=='bumper' platforms. Player._resolve_bounces snaps every contact normal to its dominant axis (_axis_snap) then calls BounceResolver.resolve_bumper (velocity.bounce(normal) * 0.86), so a bumper reflects correctly off a VERTICAL wall (horizontal reflect) and a CEILING (downward reflect), not just a floor. ArenaRenderer._paint_bumper 3-slices vertical bumper walls (h>=w) and strips horizontal ones, so the drum renders. No lethality/feel constant touched; no fake lethal wall (walls are bumper_restitution 0.86, non-lethal by construction).

GEOMETRY: two bottom TRAMPOLINE floor-shelves (LEFT x-700..-40 top1080 / RIGHT x640..1340 top1080) flank a central HOLE x-40..640 = 680px open to the void below. LEFT + RIGHT vertical BUMPER walls (inner faces flush with the shelf outer edges x-700 / x1340) run from the ceiling down past the shelf, and a BUMPER CEILING lid spans the full inner width at y-300..-200 (bottom face y-200) -> a sealed drum, single exit = the hole. Two mid-height SPRING pads (LEFT x-540..-200 / RIGHT x820..1160, top y520) sit 560px above the shelves for vertical play. Bounds are set generously OUTSIDE the walls/lid (they are failsafes only — the bumpers stop any side/top ring-out before the bounds line), so the ONLY reachable kill line is the bottom under the hole.

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270px / bubblegum 180 / spring 480; air_drift_max 340px/s, gravity 1600 => zero-boost horizontal reach ~395px off a trampoline, ~527px off a spring; normal_boost_max 760px/s crosses a 680px gap in <1s @ ~26 fuel, bounce refunds +20; super_boost_impulse 2800 clears everything but dumps the tank):
- CROSS THE CENTRE HOLE (shelf-to-shelf): left shelf right edge x-40 to right shelf left edge x640 = 680px of open void. > 527 (max spring drift; no spring sits at shelf height) and >> 395 (trampoline drift off the shelves). NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; a bounce-hop drifts at most 395px and drops into the hole. Verb: FLY. (Rule A.)
- CLIMB to a side SPRING pad (top y520): 560px above the shelf top (y1080), and the best floor bounce is the trampoline apex 270 -> only reaches y810 (270px short even before you note a spring bounce from the floor would need a spring on the floor, which there is none). JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED; an under-shot climb drops back to the shelf or into the hole. Verb: FLY. (Rule B.)
- SUPER as the money shot / cross-map: a full super clears the whole drum diameter in one blast (contest a pad, spike a clustered rival down the hole) but drains the tank -> the committed play, not routine traversal. A mis-aimed super into the bumper lid rebounds DOWN toward the hole. Verb: FLY+SMASH. (Rule C.)
- RECOVER after being knocked toward the hole: the drop from the hole mouth (y1080) to the bottom bound (y1900) is 820px of open sky (shelf bottom y1208 -> 692px, both >= 650) -> a fuelled player boosts back up out of the hole mouth (recovery gamble); a near-hole dead-on down-smash or a starved/damaged victim goes through. Verb: FLY. (Rule D.)
- Every crossing (680px hole) exceeds even a spring bounce's 527px reach and every pad sits 560px above the nearest surface (> the 480 spring apex), so NO route across or up the drum exists without the jetpack. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing.

SUCCESS CRITERIA (enclosed_hole class): DC1 single-exit >=90% of credited kills are bottom/pit (centre-hole/void) crossings, side+top (bumper) ring-outs ~=0 by construction. DC2 flight-required: fuel-pinned direction-hold from a shelf does NOT cross the 680px hole >=9/10 (falls through), a real crossing logs >=1 boost. DC3 recovery gamble: healthy full-fuel knock from mid-shelf boosts back >=6/10; near-hole dead-on down-smash sends through >=7/10. DC4 enclosure reads: screenshots confirm a closed drum (bumper lid + walls) with a lethal centre hole (dark, chevrons). VOID READS AS DEATH via the pit_void_rendering treatment (dark cool bottomless gradient + receding dirt canyon walls at the shelf inner cliffs + rim chevrons at y1080 + falling motes).
